title: WPMS/2427/2024 of ALI NAWAZ Vs BANK OF MAHARASHTRA

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports, orders or

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No.2427 of 2024
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Mamta Arya, Advocate holding brief of Ms. Prabha
Naithani, Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits at bar, on the
instructions received from her client, that some talks of
settlement between the parties is going on, therefore he does
not want to pursue the matter any further and wants to
withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to file a fresh
petition as and when the cause of action arise.
3. Permission granted.
4. Accordingly writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn
with aforesaid liberty.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 04.11.2024
